subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: Across a batch spanning every supported harness, both reconciliations run clean: every launched process in the authoritative launch record is accounted for by a schema-valid record or a capture-failure entry with none in neither (FR-13), and every required figure in every record is measured or declared unavailable with zero discrepancies (FR-15)
fit_criterion: the batch's record set + capture-failure entries + both reconciliation outputs, each read against its independent source
